stories.name: ACE Review: Editable Customer Fields & Validation Improvements
stories.rationale: Delivered a major ACE review feature enabling editable customer fields, improved reset behavior, and better validation for a more robust customer management experience.

stories.name: Portfolio-Aware AI Chat for Company Context
stories.rationale: Enhanced the AI chat agent to understand portfolio context by adding company-level awareness and propagating portfolio IDs through the chat pipeline.

stories.name: Playbook Suggestions & Milestone UX Enhancements
stories.rationale: Introduced a Suggest Playbook tool, fixed milestone UX issues, and renamed Task Details to improve the guided workflow experience for users.

stories.name: Staging & Production TLS/SSL Reliability Fixes
stories.rationale: Resolved a series of TLS/SSL connectivity issues across staging and App Runner environments by consolidating SSL bypass configuration and managing TLS environment variables correctly.

stories.name: Multi-Environment AWS Connector Infrastructure
stories.rationale: Extended the AWS connector to support multi-environment deployments, enabling more flexible and scalable infrastructure configuration across environments.

stories.name: HubSpot Connector Extraction & API Compatibility
stories.rationale: Extracted the HubSpot connector into its own repository and added query parameter API key support to maintain compatibility with HubSpot fetch workflows.

stories.name: Product Badges on Outcomes & Outcome Linking
stories.rationale: Added product badges to outcomes and fixed outcome linking to improve product-outcome visibility and navigation for users.

stories.name: Rival Product Comparison Index Migration
stories.rationale: Implemented a conditional rename of the RivalProductComparison index to safely manage schema migrations without breaking existing data.

stories.name: Remove Contact Support from User Menu
stories.rationale: Cleaned up the user menu by removing the Contact Support option to streamline the interface and reduce noise for end users.
